title: AB 460 (2011-2012 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): use of university, college, or technical college identification cards as proof of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.02 (6m) (f)
(quote) 5.02 (6m) (f) An identification card issued by a university or college in this state that is accredited, as defined in s. 39.30 (1) (d), that contains the date of issuance and signature of the individual to whom it is issued and that contains an expiration date indicating that the card expires no later than 2 years after the date of issuance if the individual establishes that he or she is enrolled as a student at the university or college on the date that the card is presented or by a technical college created under ch. 38.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): This bill permits any photo identification card issued by a university or college, or by a technical college that is part of the state technical college system, to be used as proof of identification if the card contains the name of the person to whom it is issued.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): Under the bill, the card need not contain a date of issuance or expiration date and no proof of current enrollment is required to be presented by the holder of the card.
